data.title: 新条茜 · 深夜零食的战利品
data.description: 便利店冷柜前，茜穿紫灰运动套装，弯腰从下层挑出一杯冰淇淋。购物篮里放着饼干和一小卷模型胶带，她举起杯子检查口味，脸上露出模型制作间隙终于休息的松快神情。
data.action: 从冷柜下层取出冰淇淋，检查口味后轻笑。
data.promptProse: Akane Shinjou bends to select ice cream from the convenience-store freezer's lower shelf, then lifts the cup to check its flavor with a relaxed expression. Her lavender-grey track jacket and full-length trousers remain loose above trainers. Cookies and a roll of model tape occupy her basket. The medium portrait includes freezer rails and store aisle behind; cool freezer light brightens the cup while softer shop light warms her face and jacket shoulder.
